name: database-server
description: SQL database server. The engine tells consuming packages how to address it.

fields.name: engine
fields.label: Engine
fields.help: Read by consuming packages to build their JDBC URL.

fields.name: driver
fields.label: JDBC driver
fields.help: Driver class name read by packages configuring a JDBC datasource. Follows from the engine.

fields.name: port
fields.label: Port
fields.help: 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL and MariaDB.

fields.name: username
fields.label: User
fields.help: Stored in the credentials Secret, under the username key, as the database-server contract expects.

fields.name: sslMode
fields.label: TLS mode
fields.help: 'prefer' tries TLS and falls back to clear text if the server refuses, the safe default for a server you do not control. Use 'verify-full' when the server presents a certificate your cluster trusts.

fields.name: tls
fields.label: TLS mode
fields.help: MySQL accepts a different set of values from PostgreSQL. 'preferred' tries TLS and falls back to clear text.
